justification: Inspected `byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/build/Plugin.java` around lines 2883-2944. `CompoundIterator` is a small nested helper with only one responsibility: concatenating multiple iterables. It has just 4 methods (`constructor`, `hasNext`, `next`, `remove`) plus one private helper `forward`, and only 2 fields (`current`, `backlog`); there is no evidence of multiple responsibilities, large method count, or low cohesion. I also checked analogous iterator helpers in `byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/agent/builder/AgentBuilder.java` and `byte-buddy-gradle-plugin/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/build/gradle/Adjustment.java`, which show the same compact pattern, supporting that this is a focused utility rather than insufficiently modular code.
